question: In the spray-dried natural dye study, what is the ratio of D90 to D50 for Maltodextrin 3?
rendered:
According to Table 2 on page 8 of the document "Standardisation of natural dye powders via spray drying: initial physicochemical characterisation", the particle size characteristics of the maltodextrin reference are:

| Sample | Main peak/D50 (nm) | D90 (nm) | PDI |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Maltodextrin 1 | 17.73 | 45.10 | 0.1984 |
| Maltodextrin 2 | 18.69 | 39.00 | 0.2131 |
| Maltodextrin 3 | 18.97 | 48.10 | 0.1739 |
| Mean ± SD | 18.46 ± 0.65 | 44.07 ± 4.61 | 0.1951 ± 0.0197 |

The ratio of D90 to D50 for Maltodextrin 3 is 48.10 / 18.97 ≈ 2.54.
